integrity: The complete positive-chord allocation is established analytically; finite rational checks are supplementary and no independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Priced pineapple topology with a single common positive chord price and linear budget only; later literature could contain an unindexed equivalent formula. The chord-free price screening alone follows from known tree-chord optimality principles.
title: A universal chord-price cutoff for resistance-optimal pineapple networks
